# Bundled QR libraries

These files are served locally and cached by the existing Service Worker. No runtime CDN requests are made.

- `qrcode.js`: qrcode-generator 1.4.4, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT (`qrcode-LICENSE.txt`). Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js
  SHA-256: `18AE399F81182BC9DE916E9C77B195DF20CC58D6F2D55A62B085A299F1BF1780`
- `jsQR.js`: jsqr 1.4.0, Apache-2.0 (`jsQR-LICENSE.txt`). Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js
  SHA-256: `BC40C8A15196236B2314DB0856F72CA0B49980CD5413B8C852A7349F5FEE0859`

Preserve the bundled license files when distributing the game.
